### Problem

The release candidate v7.18.1 fails the release scenarios `bug-by-person-merges`, `draft-in-conflict`, `ready-behind-main`, `review-changes-asked`, `review-replied`, `fork-without-secrets`, `merge-queue`, `low-risk-merges`, `high-risk-waits`, `conventions-fix`, `hint-no-needs-human`, `settled-rerun`, `play`, so the lane releases nothing and `v7` stays where it is.
Reproduced by: https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/44465082790 scenario `bug-by-person-merges`.

### Scope

- The cause of each failing scenario above (`bug-by-person-merges`, `draft-in-conflict`, `ready-behind-main`, `review-changes-asked`, `review-replied`, `fork-without-secrets`, `merge-queue`, `low-risk-merges`, `high-risk-waits`, `conventions-fix`, `hint-no-needs-human`, `settled-rerun`, `play`), in the engine or in the scenario's fixtures, fixed with a test that would have caught it.

### Out of scope

- Changing the gates or what they check.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given v7.18.1's candidate with the fix, when the release lane plays `bug-by-person-merges`, `draft-in-conflict`, `ready-behind-main`, `review-changes-asked`, `review-replied`, `fork-without-secrets`, `merge-queue`, `low-risk-merges`, `high-risk-waits`, `conventions-fix`, `hint-no-needs-human`, `settled-rerun`, `play` in the test repository, then each passes and the lane releases it.

### Criticality

Critical
